question.value: Can sub-millimeter water line upper limits toward HD 163296 constrain the mm dust opacity and the extent of the hot water vapor region / H2O snowline position?

evidence.quote: We compare the upper limit fluxes with the values calculated by our models with dust emission included, and we constrain the line emitting region and the dust opacity from the observations.

Upper limits depend on the assumed 30 km/s line width, which the authors say may overestimate them
Dust opacity constraint degenerate with gas-to-dust ratio and grain properties
